headline: Ireland prepares for partial solar eclipse and Perseid peak
summary: A deep partial solar eclipse and the Perseid meteor shower are both expected to put on a show across Ireland next week.
script: Skywatchers in Ireland are preparing for two big events next week: a deep partial solar eclipse and the peak of the Perseid meteor shower. The first is expected Wednesday evening.
